scripts.build:core: npm -w @tasker/core run build && npm -w @tasker/mock-caldav run build
scripts.build:web: npm run build:core && npm -w @tasker/web run build
scripts.build:fitbit: npm run build:core && npm -w @tasker/fitbit run build
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm -w @tasker/web run build && npm -w @tasker/fitbit run build
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm -w @tasker/core run test && npm -w @tasker/mock-caldav run test && npm -w @tasker/web run test && npm -w @tasker/fitbit run test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:core && npm -w @tasker/web run test:e2e && npm -w @tasker/fitbit run test:e2e
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm -w @tasker/web run dev
